readout_other: CMAP and CNAP recording; Sciatic Functional Index (walking track); toluidine blue semithin sections; RT97 and Iba1 immunostaining
direction_notes: No reliable evoked nerve or muscle action potentials under any FUS condition (skin, exposed sciatic nerve, plantar skin; also mouse and ex vivo). Direct nerve exposure reduced electrically evoked responses and caused axonal degeneration, worst at 0.25 MHz.
safety_notes: Skin irritation at 0.25 and 0.5 MHz, withdrawal responses at the paw, functional loss and nerve fibre degeneration after direct nerve exposure, most severe at 0.25 MHz (SFI -63 +/- 3).

exposures.label: Sciatic nerve (through skin, exposed nerve) and hindpaw, five transducer frequencies

device.model: H115, H107, H102 (H107 and H102 also at 3rd harmonic)

timing.protocol_description: 5 sequences of 1, 3 or 10 pulses of 1, 10, 50, 100 or 200 ms with an interstimulus interval of 100 ms; intersequence interval 1 s; pressure stepped 0, 1.25, 2.5, 3.75 and 5 MPa on each sequence.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty-two Sprague–Dawley 12-week-old rats (10 male and 12 female) and 4 Balb/c 10-week-old (2 male and 2 female) mice were used.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The full protocol for one FUS frequency was applied to each rat during one session.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: 5 sequences of 1, 3 or 10 pulses of 1, 10, 50, 100 or 200 ms duration, with an interstimulus interval of 100 ms.

flags.reason: 22 rats and 4 mice stated; total not stated separately and one ex vivo experiment used a rat that may be among the 22.
Five frequencies (H115 0.25, H107 0.5, H102 1.12 MHz and 3rd harmonics 1.63 and 3.58 MHz) recorded as a list in one exposure; focal depth and parameters otherwise shared.

Pressure range 0.1-5 MPa described as 'effective pressure'; transducers were calibrated in water under free-field conditions but the paper does not say the stated pressures are free-field values. Range also read from Table 1.
Only an interstimulus interval of 100 ms between pulses is given; PRF, duty cycle and sonication duration are not stated.
No FUS sham; electrical stimulation used as a control for recording and nerve function.
